description: Check a code snippet for security flaws before presenting or committing it. Call this before showing the user any generated code that handles authentication, sessions, database queries, user or LLM input, HTML rendering, file uploads, outbound URL fetches, secrets, or MCP configuration. Returns prioritised findings, each with evidence, a concrete fix, and a 5-minute lab. Analysis is static and deterministic; it checks at the moment of generation and is not a guarantee.

ai_generated.description: True if an AI assistant produced this code.

code.description: The code to review (a snippet or a whole file).

filename.description: Optional file name, used for language detection only.

language.description: javascript, typescript, python, or json. Detected if omitted.

name: review_code
title: Review code for security flaws
